subject: planner: move logical interface definition to base pkg (#52732)
summary: Refactor-only change: moved `LogicalPlan` (and related methods) plus `PlanCounterTp` into `pkg/planner/core/base`, added `base.AccessObject`, and updated planner/core + cascades/memo/pattern call sites to use `base.LogicalPlan` and exported method names (`FindBestTask`, `ExhaustPhysicalPlans`, `PushDownTopN`, `CanPushToCop`, etc). Reviewed the key planner hot paths impacted (task enumeration, exhaust-physical-plans, TopN pushdown signature adaptation) and found no plausible Blocker/High correctness/SQL-semantics/concurrency/compatibility regressions introduced by this commit. Checked later history up to `upstream/master` for follow-up fixes in the touched files; no evidence of a later regression-fix specifically attributable to this interface move.
